blocks.text: BANGKOK, Thailand – A huge explosion rocked an oil facility in Bangkok on Thursday, injuring nine people with three of them in a critical condition, Thai authorities said. The blast was so strong that it rattled doors several kilometres away, according to AFP reporters, who saw a column of flames above the site followed by thick black smoke. Thailand’s Energy minister Akanat Promphan, visiting the scene, said the blast sparked concern as the sprawling Phra Khanong site in eastern Bangkok was “also a residential area”.
